bib.title: Right for the Wrong Reasons: Diagnosing Syntactic Heuristics in Natural Language Inference
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 57th Annual Meeting of the ACL, pages 3428-3448

question: Do statistical NLI models trained on MNLI adopt fallible syntactic heuristics (lexical overlap, subsequence, constituent) that inflate test accuracy?
hypothesis: NLI models trained on crowdsourced data adopt the lexical overlap, subsequence and constituent heuristics, because the training data supports them and the input representations permit them.
contributions: Introduce HANS, an NLI evaluation set testing specific invalid heuristics
Show MNLI-trained models, including BERT, fail on it, consistent with having adopted the heuristics
Show the shortcomings are reduced by augmenting training data with HANS-like examples

method.summary: Template-generated evaluation set HANS (five supporting and five contradicting templates per heuristic, 1,000 examples each, 30 subcases) is used to evaluate DA, ESIM, SPINN and BERT trained on MNLI; models are then retrained with HANS-like augmentation and with withheld subcases, tested on Dasgupta et al. comparatives, and compared with MTurk and expert humans.

datasets.name: MNLI
datasets.split: standard train; MNLI test accuracy reported
datasets.preprocessing: Two-label variant merges neutral and contradiction into non-entailment in training (App D)

datasets.name: HANS
datasets.source: Template generated; core vocabulary from Ettinger et al. 2018; verbs appear at least 50 times in MNLI train in relevant frames
datasets.preprocessing: Two gold labels; 3-way model output mapped contradiction/neutral to non-entailment

datasets.name: HANS-like augmentation
datasets.split: same 30 subcases, no examples that appear in HANS

datasets.name: Dasgupta et al. 2018 comp_same_short and comp_same_long

other.note: No hyperparameters stated; code from AllenNLP, nyu-mll/spinn fork, google-research/bert

inference.decoding: argmax over entailment/contradiction/neutral, then neutral and contradiction mapped to non-entailment

other.alternative: summing contradiction and neutral scores gave little difference

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction correct per HANS subcase or heuristic, split by correct label

eval.protocol: Single reported run per model; no seeds or significance tests stated. Transfer: 5 experiments each withholding 6 of 30 subcases.

limits: Architecture vs training-set causes not separated; BERT also had far more pretraining data
HANS is template-based with limited vocabulary and sentence types
Augmentation experiment is an initial exploration; how many contradicting examples are needed is open
Transfer to withheld subcases is only partial
Only bert-base-uncased; no hyperparameters, seeds or variance reported

Assume that a premise entails all complete subtrees in its parse tree.
